scope: Resolve the failed iterative-convergence gates in the documented OpenFOAM/NASA Spalart-Allmaras Gate 1 control without changing physics, mesh, numerics, or acceptance limits.

continuation.initialization: Copy reconstructed time 5000 U, p, nuTilda, and nut fields to time zero on the identical mesh and record SHA-256 hashes.
fixed: all freestream and wall boundary conditions
12 MPI ranks, 12 CPU limit, 24g memory limit
continuation.expected_falsifiable_effect: Additional iterations reduce the final and last-100 maximum Uy initial residual and the projected 500-iteration force/moment changes. Drag agreement is assessed only if both convergence gates pass.
prohibited: changing turbulence coefficients or freestream values
advancing to stock SST before Gate 1 passes

terminal_rule: If the continuation passes iterative gates, apply the unchanged Gate 1 force and symmetry criteria. If it still fails iterative gates, retain it and diagnose the oscillatory mode before another solve. If it converges but force agreement fails, localize Cp and Cf differences before proposing a correction.
